description: This file contains JavaScript code for page transition handling, AJAX page loading, and debugging functions for the Goteo Foundation project. It manages content loading animations, event bindings, and error handling.

methods.name: getTransitionOutDeferred
methods.description: Handles the transition animation out for page content, managing deferred objects for asynchronous control.

methods.name: pageRequested
methods.description: Logs the page request event for debugging.

methods.name: pageLoadProgress
methods.description: Logs the progress of page loading.

methods.name: pageLoaded
methods.description: Logs the event of page load completion.

methods.name: prontoLoad
methods.description: Initiates AJAX page load into specified target element.

methods.name: pageRendered
methods.description: Handles post-rendering tasks such as event binding and animations.

methods.name: pageLoadError
methods.description: Handles errors during page loading, displaying an error message.
